class.name: FellowAudioDirector
class.brief_description: FellowEngine: plays [FellowSoundEvent]s within a budget of voices — variations, instance limits, cooldowns, distance, priorities and audibility — and fades the mix between [FellowMixSnapshot]s.
class.description: Add one to the scene and play sounds through it: [method play] at a place, [method play_on] following a node. It plays each in a player of a pool it keeps as its own children (reused, made as needed), with the event's variation, level and pitch; it does not play an event over its instance limit, within its cooldown or beyond its distance from the listener (the [AudioListener3D] or the camera, or [member listener_path]). [member max_voices] play at once: a new sound when they are all taken takes the voice of the least important, quietest one (its event's priority, then its level at the listener now), which fades out in [member steal_fade], when the new one is more important or louder; otherwise it is not played. Mix snapshots ([FellowMixSnapshot]) change the buses' levels: pushed and popped by the game, or active while a voice plays on their trigger bus. Its work is done in the process step; [method get_stats] counts it. See [code]docs/decisions/0190-audio-director.md[/code].

method.name: get_event_voice_count
method.description: How many voices of [param event] play.

method.name: get_snapshot_weight
method.description: How far [param snapshot] is in, 0 to 1.

method.name: get_stats
method.description: Counts since the last [method reset_stats]: [code]voices[/code], [code]fading[/code], [code]peak[/code], [code]started[/code], [code]stolen[/code] (voices given up), [code]rejected_voices[/code], [code]rejected_instances[/code], [code]rejected_cooldown[/code], [code]culled[/code] (beyond their distance), [code]finished[/code], [code]players[/code] (in the pool), [code]frames[/code], [code]usec[/code] (its process steps), [code]play_usec[/code] (its plays).

method.name: get_voice_count
method.description: How many voices play (those fading out not counted).

method.name: get_voice_player
method.description: The player ([AudioStreamPlayer3D] or [AudioStreamPlayer]) of the voice [param voice], or [code]null[/code]. Owned by the director: read it, do not keep it.

method.name: get_voices
method.description: The voices, each a dictionary: [code]id[/code], [code]event[/code], [code]priority[/code], [code]audibility_db[/code] (its level at the listener), [code]volume_db[/code], [code]bus[/code], [code]position[/code], [code]fading[/code].

method.name: is_playing
method.description: Whether the voice [param voice] plays (not ended, stopped or fading out).

method.name: play
method.description: Plays [param event] at [param position] (ignored for an event that is not spatial). Returns the voice's id, or 0 when it is not played (its instances, cooldown, distance, or no voice for it).

method.name: play_on
method.description: Plays [param event] following [param node] (its global position each frame; where it was when the node is freed). Returns the voice's id, or 0.

method.name: push_snapshot
method.description: Brings [param snapshot] in (over its [member FellowMixSnapshot.fade_in]) until it is popped.

method.name: reset_stats
method.description: Sets the counts of [method get_stats] to zero.

method.name: stop
method.description: Stops the voice [param voice], fading it out over [param fade] seconds (0: at once).

method.name: stop_all
method.description: Stops every voice, fading them out over [param fade] seconds.

method.name: stop_event
method.description: Stops every voice of [param event], fading them out over [param fade] seconds.

members.member: The node whose place is the listener's for the distances and levels; empty: the viewport's [AudioListener3D] or camera.
How many sounds play at once (voices fading out after giving theirs up not counted).
The seed of the variations' and levels' random numbers (the same seed, the same picks).
Snapshots known from the start: those with a [member FellowMixSnapshot.trigger_bus] come in while a voice plays on it; the others when pushed.
How fast a voice given up fades out, in seconds (0: at once).
When the voices are all taken, a more important or louder sound takes the voice of the least important, quietest; off: the new one is not played.

signal.name: voice_finished
signal.description: Emitted when the voice [param voice] has ended, been stopped or faded out; [param stolen]: it gave its voice to another sound.
